summary: Retest of the 2 pending items from the previous iteration. All other criteria were already validated and were not re-executed per briefing.

checks.criterion: PUT /api/produtos/{id} correctly persists explicit removal of imagemUrl (exclude_unset fix) plus name-protection / blank-name validation
checks.name: test_tscheck_produtos_remover_imagem
checks.evidence: POST /produtos with imagemUrl=/marca/refrigerante.jpg -> 201, imagemUrl set. PUT {imagemUrl:null} -> 200, imagemUrl now null; GET /produtos confirms null persisted. PUT {imagemUrl:/marca/pastel.jpg} -> 200 (icon swap works). PUT {nome:null, preco:6.75} -> 200, nome unchanged, preco updated (required field protected from null-erasure). PUT {nome:null} alone -> 400 'Nenhum campo válido para atualizar' (no field left to persist, name confirmed intact via GET). PUT {nome:'   '} -> 400. Full suite: 11 passed in 2.93s.

checks.criterion: RETESTE DO BUG CORRIGIDO — remoção da imagem do produto persiste (UI)
checks.name: produtos-biblioteca-icones-troca-remocao
checks.evidence: Admin creates product with icon from library, card renders image (naturalWidth>0), opens edit, clicks 'Remover', input clears, saves. API cross-check: GET /api/produtos for that product returns imagemUrl null/empty confirming the fix. Re-run of persisted check (reran-persisted) PASSED with 4 screenshots.

checks.criterion: Backend user-limit enforcement (400 on limit reached, DEV-only PUT /configuracoes/limiteUsuarios, 403 for admin, 400 for invalid values 0/abc)
checks.name: test_tscheck_limite_usuarios
checks.evidence: PUT limiteUsuarios by admin -> 403. PUT valor=0 by dev -> 400. PUT valor=abc by dev -> 400. Set limite=1 (dev) -> 200; POST /usuarios by admin -> 400 with 'limite' in detail message. Set limite=1000 (dev) -> 200; POST /usuarios by admin -> 201. Cleanup restores limite=5 and deletes created user. 11 passed in full backend suite.

checks.criterion: Conclusão do check pendente — limite de usuários no backend e ajuste pelo DEV (UI end-to-end)
checks.name: limite-usuarios-admin-bloqueado-dev-ajusta
checks.evidence: DEV sets limiteUsuarios=1 via API; admin tries to create employee in /funcionarios UI -> error text '/limite de usuários atingido/i' visible. DEV logs into /configuracoes, raises limit to 1000, confirmed persisted via GET /api/configuracoes. Admin retries creation -> succeeds, new row visible. Cleanup deletes the created user and restores limiteUsuarios=5. First attempt hit environment-artifact 429 from the login rate limiter (script does 5 logins per run, prior manual/API calls in the same session pushed cumulative logins over the 10/15min cap); restarted backend (sudo supervisorctl restart backend) to clear the in-memory limiter per briefing instructions and reran cleanly -> PASSED. Classified as flaky/environment artifact, not an app bug.

action_items: Environment note: repeated logins across manual curl checks + browser checks in the same short session can trip the 10-req/15min in-memory login rate limiter, causing transient 429s (e.g. mid-cleanup 'usuarios.find is not a function' when a login response was a 429 error body instead of a token). Not an app bug — restarting the backend clears it, as documented in the briefing.

Residual state note: one pre-existing tscheck-* product (id 13, created in an earlier iteration) could not be hard-deleted because it is already referenced by a historical pedido ('Este produto já foi vendido. Desative-o em vez de excluir.' — correct business-rule protection). It was deactivated (ativo=false) instead, so it no longer appears among the 5 active seeded products. Final backend state confirmed: 3 users (dev/admin/atendente), limiteUsuarios='5', 5 active products (5 seeded + 1 inactive tscheck residue not deletable due to sales history).
